title: Chetak 2901 Eco Electric
description: Representing Bajaj Auto's prowess in the Urban Electric Scooter class, the Bajaj Auto Chetak 2901 Eco Electric is delivers ultra-nimble urban agility for riders navigating congested city centers. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
